speaker: augustine_phillips
text: From the second scene. The hat is on the wrong peg, and the cue is coming in before the door.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have the cue. I learned the line after it. I will not come in early if the hat is where it was on Saturday.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The hat was on my peg. If it has walked, a hand walked it. The play did not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the hat. Say the line you have, and let the door be a door.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two of the clock is the bill. We have an hour and a bit, and a yard that knows this play.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then they will hear a late cue before they hear a wrong one. I would rather be late than be taken for the other man.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You are not the other man if the hat is mine. Say that plainly, and stand out of my light.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is naming parts at me. We are finding the entrance.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The entrance is the upstage door. Twelve paces from the property-chest. I walked them.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Twelve. I can walk twelve. I cannot walk twelve if Pope is in the doorway, telling me whose hat it is.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I am out of the doorway. The hat stays on the peg. I am not a peg.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. From Phillips's word. No talk from the chest.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: When I say "anon," you are already in the door. Not after it. In it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Anon. I have it. I had it on Saturday, and I have it this morning.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There. The peg has made its own speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pick it up. If it falls at two, let it fall, and go on.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more. Do not look at it when it falls. Look at the man you are answering.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will look at you. I will come in on "anon." I will not look at the peg.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And I will be on my side of the stage with my own head covered. That is all I ask of a Monday morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is enough to ask. Two of the clock. The rest of it has been played before, and it can be played again.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Book down. No more of the second scene until the yard is in.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will walk the twelve paces once in the yard, with no one at the chest, so I know them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Walk them. Then eat something. I want you fed before two.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Cold meat in the tiring-house will do. I am not going looking for a dinner between this and the bill.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Cold meat, and the hat back on the peg. I will look at the peg myself at the half hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the morning is done with it. The afternoon can have the play.
